additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386495-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312567479/11] SCB offline CRM:00579001247
additional_info.body:
Hello Bilel,
Greetings of the day!
With reference to trailing mail, as we can see, the charger is online on OCPP, we would recommend doing a Hard reset from "OCPP" backend and check if SCB comes back online. Once done, do let us know. Because after this, if still it is showing offline, then site intervention will be needed to check further.
Meanwhile we will inform our field service team to check the router.
Thank you
Best Regards
